The attack also wounded six other journalists. The news agency said repeated requests for an explanation had produced no substantive account from the Israeli government beyond a statement that the incident remained under review. Reuters also said questions remain unanswered about the killing of its cameraman Hussam al-Masri in an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Gaza on 25 August 2025.
